content.short: Connecting everyone, everywhere. The first mobile network owned by the people and built on blockchain.
content.description: World Mobile was founded with a far-reaching goal: to connect everyone, everywhere while advocating for economic freedom and dignity. Traditional mobile networks won't connect remote places because it’s too expensive and hard to maintain. When you discover a giant problem it’s nearly impossible to ignore it: there are nearly 4 billion people unconnected globallythat’s half the world. It turns out there’s a reason. Liberate yourself from Big Wireless. Join America's first mobile network that pays you back. World Mobile blog Stay up to date with the team. Join the first private, user‑owned mobile network with token-based rewards. $1,325 earned this week 2.2TB data transfer New AirNode available 41.184926, -74.131232 Secure the network Empower the blockchain Become an EarthNode Operator to process telco data and stake World Mobile Tokens to strengthen the network, unlocking greater rewards.
